method: The task is built by the unchanged constructor 004CCFA0 and then driven as the original coroutine: the body 004D0C60 runs unchanged from its entry; the yield 004F0D40 (vtable+0x28) is replaced by a stop that records the return point, and every later frame continues emulation from there (the setjmp/longjmp context switch of 004F0CD0/004F0D80 is modelled by this stop/continue). Inside it the think step 004D0760, dispatcher 004D02C0, plan state 004CD460, execute state 004CDC10, 004CD350, 004D0170, 004F0E40, 004CD380, 004EE960, 004EEC10, the task lookup 004CCF50, the controller/root/worm queries 004E8510/004B7970/ 004DF270, team-data getters and the event queue all execute unchanged.
